description: Move a fact to a different namespace or layer without changing its content. Updates metadata in place — preserves fact_id, text, embedding, timestamp, and deprecation chain. Use for reclassifying facts (e.g. bootstrap-v2 refactor) without the storage bloat of store-new + soft-delete-old.

fact_id.description: The UUID of the fact to move
